antecedent: A result is proved on one fixed support.
forbidden_inference: The result is valid between distinct carriers.
why_blocked: The source and target types/tokens were never separated.
minimum_additional_work: Retype source and target and prove a cross-carrier bridge.
candidate_stress_test: Compare a true fixed-support route with a disjoint-target copy.

antecedent: A formal type label or representation changes.
forbidden_inference: The physical/implementation substrate changed.
why_blocked: Type renaming and substrate individuation are different claims.
minimum_additional_work: Supply implementation maps and an independent substrate-class criterion.
candidate_stress_test: Use two encodings on the same hardware as a false positive.

antecedent: Source and target structures are isomorphic.
forbidden_inference: They are the same token or subject.
why_blocked: Isomorphism is type/structure equivalence, not token individuation.
minimum_additional_work: Add a lineage/identity criterion and route data.
candidate_stress_test: Symmetric duplicate targets.

antecedent: Source and target endpoint states match.
forbidden_inference: The source process continued.
why_blocked: A state omits history, causal route, and maintenance process.
minimum_additional_work: Prove a process/history-level invariant or state its absence.
candidate_stress_test: Same endpoint reached by copy versus live handoff.

antecedent: Endpoints match under the chosen quotient.
forbidden_inference: The routes are equivalent.
why_blocked: Holonomy can preserve endpoints while changing transported predictive structure.
minimum_additional_work: Prove route independence/confluence or compute the defect.
candidate_stress_test: Loop with fixed public endpoint and moved predictive class.

antecedent: Public behavior or reports match.
forbidden_inference: Predictive states match.
why_blocked: Current equivalence can be strictly coarser than predictive equivalence.
minimum_additional_work: Audit future-conditioned behavior under all declared continuations.
candidate_stress_test: Current-equal/future-different split pair.

antecedent: Predictive quotients match.
forbidden_inference: The full C-package is preserved.
why_blocked: C1-C8 include closure, credit, time, binding, viability, and coherence beyond prediction.
minimum_additional_work: Run clause-by-clause and coherence audits.
candidate_stress_test: Predictive match with failed C7 or C8.

antecedent: Separate witnesses exist for C1-C8.
forbidden_inference: One integrated package exists.
why_blocked: The witnesses may live on different carriers or fail coherence.
minimum_additional_work: Exhibit one carrier/package with cross-clause coherence and gates.
candidate_stress_test: Disconnected union of clause witnesses.

antecedent: The simplified certificate is satisfied.
forbidden_inference: The full C-package is satisfied.
why_blocked: No implication or equivalence is inherited.
minimum_additional_work: Prove an ordering theorem or restrict the claim to the simplified schema.
candidate_stress_test: Candidate passing simplified proxies but failing a full clause.

antecedent: A certificate check passes.
forbidden_inference: The certificate is sound for lawful closure.
why_blocked: Satisfaction and semantic soundness are different propositions.
minimum_additional_work: Prove certificate soundness or list it as H-CERT-SOUND.
candidate_stress_test: Adversarial false-positive package.

antecedent: The target satisfies a structural package.
forbidden_inference: The target is conscious.
why_blocked: Structural realization is Tier S; consciousness is Tier O.
minimum_additional_work: State H-CERT-SOUND/A1 or another explicit ontological bridge.
candidate_stress_test: Refuse A1 while retaining the structural theorem.

antecedent: The target is conscious under an ontological premise.
forbidden_inference: It is the continuation of the source.
why_blocked: Target realization and source-target lineage are independent.
minimum_additional_work: Supply a separate S-L theorem and identity premise if desired.
candidate_stress_test: Independent conscious target with no bridge.

antecedent: An exact copy is produced.
forbidden_inference: There is one uniquely continuing target.
why_blocked: Symmetric copies can satisfy the same fidelity relation.
minimum_additional_work: Add an asymmetry-producing criterion or return underdetermined/branch-valued.
candidate_stress_test: Two exact simultaneous copies.

antecedent: The source is destroyed.
forbidden_inference: Transfer succeeded or uniqueness is restored.
why_blocked: Deletion removes a competitor but does not create a lineage relation.
minimum_additional_work: Evaluate lineage before and after deletion under one declared criterion.
candidate_stress_test: Copy-then-delete versus failed-copy-then-delete.

antecedent: The source remains active.
forbidden_inference: Transfer failed.
why_blocked: Nondestructive continuation may be branch-valued or plural.
minimum_additional_work: Evaluate the candidate relation under source persistence.
candidate_stress_test: Live migration followed by overlapping operation.

antecedent: Replacement is gradual and overlapping.
forbidden_inference: Identity is preserved.
why_blocked: Continuity of material replacement is not yet continuity of the selected object.
minimum_additional_work: Prove preservation along every stage and handle branching.
candidate_stress_test: Gradual route with hidden predictive reset.

antecedent: There is an unbroken causal chain.
forbidden_inference: Personal identity or full structural continuation holds.
why_blocked: Causal dependence can transmit only a public shadow or defective package.
minimum_additional_work: Name and prove the causally preserved invariant.
candidate_stress_test: Causal copier with failed autonomy or C7.

antecedent: The bridge is a one-to-one function.
forbidden_inference: Token identity is preserved.
why_blocked: Injectivity is a map property, not an identity theorem.
minimum_additional_work: Add quotient/lineage compatibility and token-individuation rules.
candidate_stress_test: Bijective serialization between distinct tokens.

antecedent: Definitions or code are polymorphic in carrier type.
forbidden_inference: A2 or substrate independence is proved.
why_blocked: Uniform syntax does not prove realizability or invariance.
minimum_additional_work: State and prove H-XCI for the chosen semantics.
candidate_stress_test: Instantiate the type with a carrier lacking required dynamics.

antecedent: A2-P is accepted.
forbidden_inference: A cross-carrier bridge exists or preserves the package.
why_blocked: A2-P is ontological/philosophical, not a structural transport theorem.
minimum_additional_work: Prove S-T/H-XCI separately.
candidate_stress_test: Carrier pair with no admissible bridge.

antecedent: One admissible route exists.
forbidden_inference: Transport is route-independent or compositional.
why_blocked: Alternate routes may have nonzero holonomy.
minimum_additional_work: Prove flatness/confluence or report route dependence.
candidate_stress_test: Two routes with matched endpoints and distinct predictive images.

antecedent: Two routes share endpoints.
forbidden_inference: Their transported packages are equal.
why_blocked: Endpoint equality may hide route records and memory.
minimum_additional_work: Compare the transported object, not only endpoints.
candidate_stress_test: Protocol trap or memory-wheel loop.

antecedent: All local or pairwise bridge conditions pass.
forbidden_inference: A globally coherent package or lineage exists.
why_blocked: Local data may fail to glue globally.
minimum_additional_work: Supply global admissibility/coherence or obstruction-empty theorem.
candidate_stress_test: Three-context cycle with inconsistent global assignment.

antecedent: The target works while source/bridge/decoder remains active.
forbidden_inference: The target is autonomous.
why_blocked: External support may determine or repair the target state.
minimum_additional_work: Apply a declared withdrawal intervention.
candidate_stress_test: Decoder-off control.

antecedent: The target is viable at handoff.
forbidden_inference: It remains autonomously viable.
why_blocked: Snapshot viability does not prove future maintenance.
minimum_additional_work: Prove maintained viability over H under target dynamics/resources.
candidate_stress_test: Target collapses one step after support removal.

antecedent: A reverse protocol recovers the source-level structure.
forbidden_inference: The same token persisted.
why_blocked: Reversibility of a transformation does not decide token identity.
minimum_additional_work: Add an S-L criterion and route composition audit.
candidate_stress_test: Serialize/deserialise to a new token and back.

antecedent: One invariant is exactly preserved.
forbidden_inference: All clauses, coherence, lineage, or consciousness are preserved.
why_blocked: Exactness is object-specific.
minimum_additional_work: List and audit every required invariant separately.
candidate_stress_test: Preserve M while viability collapses.

antecedent: Public outputs are approximately matched.
forbidden_inference: Hidden/predictive/package structure is approximately matched.
why_blocked: No metric relation is inherited between these spaces.
minimum_additional_work: Define cross-space error bounds or withhold the inference.
candidate_stress_test: Small output error with large future divergence.

antecedent: The package persists for a finite horizon.
forbidden_inference: It persists indefinitely.
why_blocked: Finite verification does not imply invariant maintenance.
minimum_additional_work: Prove an invariant/greatest-fixed-point condition or retain finite scope.
candidate_stress_test: Delayed failure beyond tested horizon.

antecedent: A relation-valued lineage descends.
forbidden_inference: There is a unique successor.
why_blocked: A relation may be many-valued by design.
minimum_additional_work: Prove functional/unique status or report multiplicity.
candidate_stress_test: Symmetric fission.

antecedent: Fission is classified as branching.
forbidden_inference: One branch is the original.
why_blocked: Branch classification alone does not select a privileged branch.
minimum_additional_work: Add a principled asymmetry or return no unique verdict.
candidate_stress_test: Perfect symmetric branches.

antecedent: Several source lineages fuse into one target.
forbidden_inference: Every source survives as that target.
why_blocked: Many-to-one mapping may merge or erase distinctions.
minimum_additional_work: Specify retention, merge defects, and identity interpretation.
candidate_stress_test: Fusion with one source’s predictive distinction erased.

antecedent: The target has a nonempty viability kernel.
forbidden_inference: The target is conscious.
why_blocked: Viability is controlled persistence only.
minimum_additional_work: Establish the named structural package and ontological bridge.
candidate_stress_test: Viable thermostat/control.

antecedent: The target viability kernel is empty.
forbidden_inference: The source subject is metaphysically dead.
why_blocked: The fact is structural and criterion-relative.
minimum_additional_work: Separate empty-target S-L fact from any Tier-O death reading.
candidate_stress_test: Empty package target with preserved archive.

antecedent: A determining state is hidden from declared channels.
forbidden_inference: It is absolutely unknowable or private from every instrument.
why_blocked: Hiddenness is interface-relative.
minimum_additional_work: Quantify over expanded interfaces or retain declared-channel scope.
candidate_stress_test: Add a decoder channel that dissolves hiddenness.

antecedent: No public-only criterion can determine lineage.
forbidden_inference: Cross-carrier continuation is impossible.
why_blocked: The no-go excludes an evidence class, not all structural criteria.
minimum_additional_work: State the quantified criterion class exactly.
candidate_stress_test: Hidden-state-aware bridge succeeds.

antecedent: A recognition mapping fails empirically.
forbidden_inference: The structural mathematics is false.
why_blocked: Recognition is retractable unless imported into the theorem.
minimum_additional_work: Downgrade/reject the R bridge only.
candidate_stress_test: Alternative instrument maps same structure differently.

antecedent: A structural theorem is proved.
forbidden_inference: A phenomenal or survival conclusion follows.
why_blocked: Tier-O content requires named premises.
minimum_additional_work: State the exact conditional and refusal cost.
candidate_stress_test: Reader refuses A1/A2.

antecedent: An engineering or biological analogue works.
forbidden_inference: The consciousness-transfer candidate is evidenced.
why_blocked: Analogy generates hypotheses but does not discharge them.
minimum_additional_work: Extract shared formal structure and prove it in the target model.
candidate_stress_test: QEC analogue with missing lineage criterion.

antecedent: A repair reconstructs the declared structure.
forbidden_inference: The original token/lineage was preserved through failure.
why_blocked: Repair may create a new matching instance.
minimum_additional_work: Audit information provenance and apply the S-L criterion across the gap.
candidate_stress_test: Destroy-and-reconstruct from archive.

antecedent: A description translates losslessly.
forbidden_inference: The source process migrated.
why_blocked: Representation transport may omit dynamics, timing, support, and repair.
minimum_additional_work: Prove process-level simulation and handoff/autonomy.
candidate_stress_test: Static snapshot loaded into inert target.

antecedent: Source and target map to a common abstract object or span apex.
forbidden_inference: A causal handoff or lineage exists.
why_blocked: Common abstraction gives comparison, not causal or historical connection.
minimum_additional_work: Add route/history data and lineage relation.
candidate_stress_test: Independent implementations of the same specification.

antecedent: A package is distributed across multiple carrier tokens.
forbidden_inference: There are many subjects, one subject, or a fusion.
why_blocked: Distribution topology does not decide binding or lineage.
minimum_additional_work: Audit C7/global package and state the S-L criterion.
candidate_stress_test: Same network with binding on/off.

antecedent: The target is post-handoff autonomous.
forbidden_inference: It is the source’s continuation.
why_blocked: Autonomy is a maintenance property, not historical lineage.
minimum_additional_work: Supply an independent S-L relation.
candidate_stress_test: Autonomous independently initialized target.

antecedent: A package is exact at the endpoint.
forbidden_inference: Its temporal closure and action-credit history were preserved.
why_blocked: C5/C6 may depend on route and endogenous provenance.
minimum_additional_work: Audit historical/provenance-sensitive clauses.
candidate_stress_test: Endpoint clone with externally scheduled history.

antecedent: The target is behaviorally indistinguishable from the source.
forbidden_inference: The target is the same source token.
why_blocked: Indistinguishability is quotient-relative and permits duplicates.
minimum_additional_work: Add predictive/package/lineage tests.
candidate_stress_test: Two black-box-identical targets.

antecedent: A1 is accepted.
forbidden_inference: A declared lineage relation is personal identity.
why_blocked: A1 concerns realization from closure, not predecessor identity.
minimum_additional_work: Add H-IDENTITY-O or another explicit metaphysical bridge.
candidate_stress_test: Two realized symmetric branches under A1.

antecedent: The full C-package is satisfied on source and target.
forbidden_inference: Substrate indifference or cross-medium transfer follows.
why_blocked: Two local realizations do not supply a bridge or invariance theorem.
minimum_additional_work: Prove H-XCI and S-T/S-L separately; price A2-P only ontologically.
candidate_stress_test: Independent full-package instances with no route.

antecedent: A declared structural defect is small.
forbidden_inference: The target is “almost the same person” or lineage is approximately preserved.
why_blocked: Metric magnitude has no lineage meaning without a threshold, stability theorem, and criterion.
minimum_additional_work: Declare metric, threshold, horizon, stability margin, and a separate S-L interpretation.
candidate_stress_test: Construct a small-defect case that crosses a viability or branching boundary.

antecedent: An exact result is proved on one finite toy carrier.
forbidden_inference: The same law holds for large, noisy, continuous, or arbitrary carriers.
why_blocked: Toy exactness is carrier-scoped and may use special symmetries.
minimum_additional_work: State a conditional family/approximate theorem and discharge its hypotheses separately.
candidate_stress_test: Perturb the toy symmetry or enlarge the carrier while preserving superficial outputs.

antecedent: A property is robust under one declared perturbation family.
forbidden_inference: The property is robust in general.
why_blocked: Robustness is perturbation-relative.
minimum_additional_work: Quantify the allowed perturbations, norm, radius, and margins.
candidate_stress_test: Use an excluded perturbation that targets a critical clause.

antecedent: A scalar fidelity or average error is high.
forbidden_inference: Every critical C-package clause is preserved.
why_blocked: A scalar can average away a hard-gate failure.
minimum_additional_work: Report clause-wise/vector defects and hard gates.
candidate_stress_test: Build a high-average-fidelity target that loses binding or viability.

antecedent: The target has sufficient resource or maintenance budget.
forbidden_inference: The target carries the source package or lineage.
why_blocked: Resources enable structures but do not determine which structure or ancestry is present.
minimum_additional_work: Audit the package and lineage independently.
candidate_stress_test: Compare two different packages with the same resource budget.

antecedent: The target preserves an input-output computation or Boolean function.
forbidden_inference: The full consciousness-relevant package is preserved.
why_blocked: C1-C8 include hidden, reflexive, temporal, binding, action-credit, and viability structure beyond function.
minimum_additional_work: List and test the noncomputational package clauses.
candidate_stress_test: Use two implementations with the same function and different predictive/maintenance organization.

antecedent: No difference is observed under the available tests.
forbidden_inference: No structurally relevant difference exists.
why_blocked: The test family may be incomplete or identify hidden continuation distinctions.
minimum_additional_work: State identifiability limits and quantify the tested interface.
candidate_stress_test: Add an admissible future continuation that separates the pair.

antecedent: A criterion labels the intended examples correctly.
forbidden_inference: The criterion is noncircular and explanatory.
why_blocked: Bridge data, labels, or definitions may hard-code the intended verdict.
minimum_additional_work: Run label permutation, symmetric-copy, counterfeit, and bridge-ablation controls.
candidate_stress_test: Swap target labels or remove the privileged field used by the criterion.

antecedent: One candidate survives the attacks explored so far.
forbidden_inference: It should be frozen as the project target.
why_blocked: Other candidates, scenarios, assumptions, or external objections may remain unexamined.
minimum_additional_work: Wait for the CST-EXP-06 comparison and hard gates.
candidate_stress_test: Find a nearest alternative that agrees on easy cases and differs on one discriminator.

antecedent: Target outputs persist after withdrawal.
forbidden_inference: The target autonomously maintains the full internal package.
why_blocked: Outputs may be cached, replayed, or generated by a degraded organization.
minimum_additional_work: Audit predictive update, hiddenness, viability, repair, and clause coherence after withdrawal.
candidate_stress_test: Use a replay/cache target with stable outputs and collapsed internal update.

antecedent: There is a temporal gap with no active package.
forbidden_inference: Lineage is extinct or, conversely, preserved.
why_blocked: A gap alone decides neither; retained records and the lineage criterion matter.
minimum_additional_work: Declare dormancy, retained object, recovery process, and criterion-relative verdict.
candidate_stress_test: Compare erased, cryptographically retained, and reconstructible-but-noncausal records.

antecedent: Source and target induce the same predictive quotient.
forbidden_inference: They have the same hidden implementation, support, or token.
why_blocked: Many carrier implementations can realize one quotient.
minimum_additional_work: Declare implementation equivalence or retain underdetermination.
candidate_stress_test: Construct two nonisomorphic carriers with isomorphic predictive quotients.
